The graph shows the current against voltage characteristics of four different electronic devices W, X, Y and Z. One of the devices is an $8 \Omega$ resistor and one is a filament lamp rated $9 \text{W}$ at $6 \text{V}$. You may assume that the filament lamp does not 'blow' in the context of this question.
a) Which of the devices is the resistor?
